description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Client_HttpException, which is a specific exception class used within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC client component to handle HTTP errors during XML-RPC method calls.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_HttpException
classes.description: A custom exception class thrown when an HTTP error occurs during an XML-RPC method call in the Zend Framework's XML-RPC client.
